title: Private pages: track every reader and click on /how, /facilities and /lab, and show it in admin

source.ref: Requested by Daniel, 2026-11-17 (project thread): 'I want to track every reader and click on the private pages.'

detail: WHAT: the /how tracker (lib/how/brief-tracker.ts, moved from app/(brief)/how) now runs on /facilities and /lab too (components/frequency/site/shell/private-page-tracker.tsx). Each batch names its page from PRIVATE_PAGES (lib/how/brief-events.ts) and the beacon refuses any other. The ?r= reader code carries across the private pages in one tab. Clicks are page-wide: every link, button and expander (kind header/footer/link/button/expand plus the brief's rail/nav/next kinds) with its label and target, and every form submit with only the option picked in its select, never typed text. All first-party in engagement_events; GA still gets only the anonymous milestones, never the reader code. VIEW: the Private pages section at the bottom of the Growth dashboard, /admin/growth#private-pages (not its own route: a new route is a new function and the deploy sat at 7.99 of the 8 GB check:build-budget, so a separate page failed the build): one row per reader (pages, last seen, visits, engaged time, scroll, clicks, finished, device) and the click log, newest first, Pacific time.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=f=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'):'';const bad=[];const ev=r('lib/how/brief-events.ts');for(const p of ['/how','/facilities','/lab'])if(!ev.includes(\"'\"+p+\"'\"))bad.push('page '+p);if(!r('app/api/how/beacon/route.ts').includes('page: batch.page'))bad.push('beacon page');for(const p of ['facilities','lab'])if(!r('app/(marketing)/'+p+'/page.tsx').includes('PrivatePageTracker page='))bad.push(p+' untracked');const t=r('lib/how/brief-tracker.ts');if(!t.includes(\"document.addEventListener('click', onClick, true)\")||!t.includes(\"document.addEventListener('submit', onSubmit, true)\"))bad.push('clicks');if(!r('components/widgets/growth/private-pages.tsx').includes('loadPrivateReads'))bad.push('admin view');if(!r('app/(main)/admin/growth/page.tsx').includes('<GrowthPrivatePages />'))bad.push('not on Growth');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-2345: '+bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails if a private page stops sending its page name or loses its tracker, the beacon stops recording the page, click or form capture is removed, or the admin view or its menu row goes away.
